title: With World Cup games over, the stickers can be removed from 64,000 seats at Gillette Stadium

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With World Cup games over, the stickers can be removed from 64,000 seats at Gillette Stadium
sources.description: France's 2-0 win over Morocco in the quarterfinal round of the World Cup was the seventh, and last, game of the tournament played at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough.
